events.title: Discovery
events.detail: Discovered by the ATLAS survey telescope at Río Hurtado, Chile — the third known interstellar object

events.title: Solar conjunction
events.detail: Only 2.6° from the Sun as seen from Earth — hidden in solar glare

events.title: Perihelion
events.detail: Closest to the Sun: 1.356 AU (203 million km), speed 68.3 km/s

events.title: Crosses the ecliptic
events.detail: Passes through the planets' orbital plane (descending node)

events.title: End of observed arc
